findings:
🟠 [stdin-paths-quote-prefix] MUST-FIX `git hash-object --stdin-paths` C-unquotes any input line whose first byte is `"` (builtin/hash-object.c `hash_stdin_paths`), so a tracked regular file whose name starts with a double quote is hashed as a different path or makes git die("line is badly quoted"); `verifyTreeIntegrity` then throws a raw git error (or a false mismatch) for a valid tree where base hashed it correctly via `--stdin`. Impact: packet build fails for any repo containing such a file, blocking every review of that candidate. Smallest fix: in `verifyTreeIntegrity`, route `rel.startsWith('"')` through the per-file `module.exports.hashObject` branch alongside LF/CR names; add that name to the review-packet fixture (call count becomes 3).
🟠 [runpanel-build-uncaught] MUST-FIX `runPanel` calls `buildPacketOnce(...)` before the `try`, and `buildReviewPacket` throws on tree-integrity, deny-list and git failures. At base those throws were caught inside `prepareReviewLaunch` and surfaced as a `skipLaunch` seat row; now they propagate out of `runPanel`, so one bad build aborts the whole panel with no seat receipts or ledger rows. Smallest fix: wrap the shared build in try/catch; on failure set `sharedPacket = null` and record the error so every seat is `precondition_failed` with that reason (or fall back to per-seat builds), keeping the existing receipt shape.
🔵 [shared-build-gate] CUT/FOLLOW-UP the shared build runs whenever the real dispatcher is used, and `reviewOptions.sharedPacket` is attached outside the guard that sets `reviewOptions.packet`; a panel whose seats would not receive `options.packet` still pays a full build that is then disposed unused. Gate both on the same predicate. Excluded as MUST-FIX only because the seat-side path is still inside the blind-discovery branch, so no wrong artifact reaches a seat.
🔵 [prepare-error-reclass] CUT/FOLLOW-UP the engine early-return fires on any `skipLaunch`, so every prepare-time error (mkdtemp, deny-list, git) is now `precondition_failed` and skips the `dispatch_review` ledger push, where base classified them via the existing error path. Narrow the early return to `reviewResult.phase === 'precondition_failed'`. Not spec-mandated beyond the mismatch case, so not blocking.
🔵 [solo-identity-not-pinned] CUT/FOLLOW-UP the runner test compares two current solo runs to each other, not to a base-pinned hash and arg shape, so it cannot detect drift from fd4ea3a6. Pin the base-observed `packet_hash` and arg shape in the test. Test-strength item, not a product defect.
🔵 [lstat-before-compare-order] CUT/FOLLOW-UP a later missing/wrong-type entry now throws before an earlier oid mismatch because the lstat pass precedes the compare pass; base reported the earlier mismatch. Both are failures, message text per entry is unchanged, so excluded.
🔵 [sha1-batch-cwd-discovery] CUT/FOLLOW-UP in the sha1 case the batch runs with cwd=treeDir and no `GIT_DIR`, so git discovers whatever repo encloses the temp dir; base ran with cwd=repo. Setting `GIT_DIR` (or `-c` with the throwaway dir) unconditionally removes the dependency. Excluded as an edge with no observed failure under `os.tmpdir()`.
